data.content_ref: inline:The target posits a dependence from SRC_002's resilience model on a clean control plane, but the stated refutation ('if the presence of a global control plane creates a meta-correlation... via a single configuration error') merely restates the anti-property of that same assumed premise (a global, un-isolated control plane) rather than specifying the concrete failure mechanism by which failures synchronize across redundancy pools; the 'relation' is thus a one-ended premise with no substantive named kind tying the endpoints.
